classes.name: EAGL::RenderContext

The Xbox layout is a D3D port and does not follow the PS2 one (PS2 fields at +0x74c..+0x87c). +0x0/+0x4 hold the object's own address (extension/private views). classes.name: EAGL::ViewPort

Ctor calls e4b90(this) and e4bb0(this+0x10) (extension/private ctors) and copies identity (ptr 0x1cdb70) into the three matrices. PS2 mapping: +0x4/+0x8 same; PS2 +0x10..+0x1c -> Xbox +0x28..+0x34 (+0x18; Xbox-only block at +0x10); PS2 matrices +0x20/+0x60/+0xa0 and everything up to +0x154 -> +0x20; PS2 +0x168 int -> Xbox bool +0x188. PS2 +0x16c..+0x190 (guard band etc.) has no Xbox counterpart seen. Confirms RRenderer+0x68 / RViewCamera+0x18 ViewPort*.

notes: MISNAMED: 0xf3520 'EAGL::RenderContext::GetCurrentViewPort' returns [this+0x24] = TextureRenderContext's current viewport (next to TRC NewViewPort f34b0/DeleteViewPort f3540, TRC list at +0x28); 0xee080 'EAGL::TextureRenderContext::GetCurrentViewPort' returns [this+0x138] = RenderContext's (next to RC NewViewPort ee010/DeleteViewPort ee0a0, RC list at +0x13c). The two names are swapped. Evidence-file pointer hints naming these two functions (RenderContext +0x24, ViewPort +0x28/+0x2c) should be read with the swap.

0xe8900 Device::NewRenderContext is typed '__fastcall void (void *)': it is __thiscall and returns the new RenderContext * (EAX); it also stores it in global 0x23fb64 (current render context). Device instance global 0x23fb60.
Device::Init 0xe4f70 returns bool (SETNZ AL on the result of 0x169450, which is stored in 0x23ff14).
0xf34b0 TextureRenderContext::NewViewPort return type is by analogy with RenderContext::NewViewPort ee010 (not disassembled).

Size confirmations for earlier layouts: Device 0x1c (RRenderer +0x60), RenderContext 0x14c (+0x64), ViewPort 0x1a0 (+0x68, RViewCamera +0x18), DynamicModel 0x58 (RGain +0x70 byte array 0x58: correct), DynamicLoader 0x1c (new(0x1c) in earlier clusters). EAGL::Model has no allocation: 0xd8 from the PS2 copy ctor and the access range; model data comes from the loader so offsets are shared by both builds.
EAGL::Transform is 0x40 bytes (16 floats) on both builds; Model +0xc, DynamicModel +0x0 and the ViewPort matrices could equally be typed EAGL::Transform instead of MATRIX4.

RenderContext/Device/TextureRenderContext on Xbox are D3D rewrites: RenderContext +0x0/+0x4 and Device +0x0 hold the object's own address (extension/private views of the same object). RenderContext +0xb8 is addr-taken and zeroed with the D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS block; +0xb8 itself left undefined.
EAGL::GeoPrimState (RStateManager array, 0x4c stride) was not in this packet; EAGL::DrawArray is also 0x4c but unrelated.
